name: Sheet
description: A modal panel that slides in from the right edge for details or editing.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when it should open or close (Escape, overlay click, close button).

a11y: Native <dialog> opened with showModal(): focus is trapped, the page is inert and Escape closes it.
Named by its title with aria-labelledby; focus returns to the trigger when it closes.
